AGILE TERMAGANT KYTON
CR 19/MR 1

XP 204,800
Agile termagant kyton
LE Large outsider (evil, extraplanar, kyton, lawful)
Init +28/+8, dual initiative; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +28

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 16, flat-footed 26 (+4 Dex, +3 dodge, +17 natural, –1 size)
hp 290 (17d10+197); regeneration 10 (good weapons and spells, silver weapons)
Fort +21, Ref +11, Will +20
Defensive Abilities evasion, hard to kill; DR 10/good and silver; Immune cold; SR 28

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft., fly 70 ft. (perfect)
Melee 2 slams +27 (1d8+11/19–20 plus bleed) or storm of chains +27 (2d6+15/x2) , 7 tentacles +22 (1d6+5 plus grab)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks bleed (2d6), mythic power (0/day, surge +1d6), poison, rupture, shared rupture, unnerving gaze

TACTICS

Before Combat The God-Seer throws the storm of chains at the PCs.

During Combat Every other round, the kyton births another feral kyton, this goes on until she is dead or the PCs are. These kyton are very much fully grown and angry. They immediately seek to attack anyone attacking the God-Seer.

STATISTICS

Str 33, Dex 18, Con 33, Int 22, Wis 27, Cha 22
Base Atk +17; CMB +29 (+33 grapple); CMD 46 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Dodge, Improved Critical (slam), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Mobility, Spring Attack
Skills Acrobatics +4 (+12 to jump), Bluff +26, Fly +30, Heal +28, Intimidate +26, Knowledge (arcana) +23, Knowledge (engineering) +23, Knowledge (history) +23, Knowledge (planes) +26, Knowledge (religion) +26, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28, Stealth +20
Languages Aboleth, Common, Dwarven, Infernal, Weirdling; telepathy 100 ft.
Gear storm of chains (see page 74)
